text_block_list.text: It's the day after Mihono Bourbon's debut race…

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: Thank you for giving me some of your time today, Mihono Bourbon.
A reporter for an Umamusume magazine has come to interview her.

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: First, let me say that you had a stunning debut. We were all left speechless.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: May I ask you about your future plans?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My ultimate goal is to win the Classic Triple Crown. In other words, I aim to win the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so?! I was certain that you would be aiming to tackle the sprints.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, I intend to run in the Classics. The Triple Crown has been my dream since I was a child.

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. So you're saying that through continued training, you've found a way to compete in medium- and long-distance races?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I can't say that I have the confidence yet. I'm still best suited for sprints.

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: …Oh?
Mihono Bourbon returns the reporter's baffled look with one of her own.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: No, um… I'm just a little surprised you would choose the path you have if that's how you feel…

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: It would be a real shame if you were to get injured.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My goal is the Triple Crown. This is non-negotiable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thus, I will train every day to improve my stamina for longer races.

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: I-I see…
Not truly convinced, the reporter leaves. Several days later…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Mihono Bourbon, the big-name rookie many had pegged as the next top sprinter, has unexpectedly set her sights on the Triple Crown…"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Leaving fans who had high hopes for her bewildered."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Analysis complete. This is "criticism," is it not?
That bit about fan bewilderment sounds a little fishy. It's possible the reporter just made it up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But I received multiple remarks that I interpreted as being similar while I was running off-campus earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Retrieving voice data.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "It's better to stick with what you're good at. You should rethink this, for your own sake."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Forcing yourself to run like this is dangerous. We're telling you this because we care."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It appears they may have read this article and proceeded to wait for me to leave campus.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I assume that these people think that I'm being reckless.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It does not necessarily bother me, but I did not anticipate the extent of their displeasure.
choice_data_list: I can't believe they'd go so far as to lie in wait for you…

text_block_list.text: This isn't the first time this has happened, actually.

text_block_list.name: New Master
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Mihono Bourbon's aiming for the Classic Triple Crown? What a waste! Why doesn't she stick to sprinting?!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Are you sure it's okay to put Mihono Bourbon through such brutal training?

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Former Master
text_block_list.text: …You belong in short-distance races, Bourbon.
Nobody was being malicious, but none of them had faith in her decision.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Lowered eyebrows. Tightened lips. I have identified "sadness" in your expression, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Why are you experiencing "sadness"?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Can further effort on my part resolve this "frustration"?
I'm unsure how to explain myself to the confused Mihono Bourbon.
She hasn't done anything wrong—people just don't believe in her because we don't have the results to back up her decision.
In that case…
choice_data_list: We'll have to prove ourselves in the next race.

text_block_list.text: If we can get results that'll convince people she's got what it takes to become a Triple Crown champion…
Then the way everyone sees her might just change.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But our next race is the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes, a mile race of 1,600 meters.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That kind of distance still doesn't measure up to the races for the Classic Triple Crown. Will winning this be enough?
choice_data_list: You'll just have to show everyone how good you are.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: How good I am?
We'll show them that she can maintain her impressive speed all the way until the end, even at longer distances.
When I tell her that we can show them that she has that kind of strength and grit at the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. My analysis shows that you desire a style of running that will quell everyone's doubts.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order acknowledged. I will change the public's perception at the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.
Our days of training together for the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes begin now!
